$schema_note: Machine-checked source-to-test ownership. Every production module under packages/core, apps/api/src (non-scripts), and apps/web/src must appear here with layers and tests, or an explicit exclude reason. An entry may never leave tests empty while a test file that imports the module sits in the same directory; check-test-coverage-map.mjs fails on that. Status deferred alongside real tests means some layer this entry names is not attached yet, not that nothing proves the module.
